Help Qadam become a real AI

Qadam is a little delivery robot from Astana. Right now it is a simple reflex bot. Each island teaches it one week of AI Fundamentals. Finish all ten and it becomes a talking AI.

🏝️

1. Pick an island

Each island is one week of the course. The golden beam shows where to go next. Tap an island, then press 🧪 Enter the 3D lab.

🎯

2. Complete 3 missions

Every lab has a 🎯 goal box with 3 missions. Stuck? Press 💡 How? and it tells you exactly what to click. Each mission gives one ⭐.

📖

3. Learn the theory

The yurt in the middle is the Library: the full textbook with worked exam problems, live Python and quizzes. Read a chapter, then try it on its island.

⭐

Collect all 30 stars

3 stars × 10 islands. Your progress is saved on this device. Ready? Start with Island 1: Sensor Spire.
